name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash vllm 0.26.0
description: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 专属镜像 + 双节点 TP=2 vLLM 服务：GB10 定向 overlay、InstantTensor 快速加载、dspark 投机、DS-MLA 量化 KV、1M 上下文。
compose_template:
services:
  vllm-b12x:
    image: ${VLLM_IMAGE:-ghcr.io/skymaze/fireworks-models/deepseek-v4-flash-0731:0.3.1}
    container_name: ${TASK_NAME}-rank${NODE_RANK}
    pull_policy: if_not_present
    entrypoint: []
    network_mode: host
    ipc: host
    shm_size: "64gb"
    ulimits:
      memlock: -1
      stack: 67108864
    gpus: all
    devices:
      - /dev/infiniband:/dev/infiniband
    volumes:
      - ${HF_CACHE:-${HOME}/.cache/huggingface}:/cache/huggingface
      - ${HOME}/.cache/vllm-cache:/cache/vllm-cache
      - ${HOME}/.cache/dspark-tmp:/tmp
    environment:
      HF_HOME: /cache/huggingface
      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: "1"
      HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET: "1"
      VLLM_CACHE_ROOT: /cache/vllm-cache
      DG_JIT_CACHE_DIR: /tmp/deep-gemm
      VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN: "1"
      TILELANG_CLEANUP_TEMP_FILES: "1"
      TILELANG_CACHE_DIR: "/cache/vllm-cache/tilelang"
      TRITON_CACHE_DIR: "/cache/vllm-cache/triton"
      VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: "3600"
      VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH: "0"
      VLLM_HOST_IP: "${VLLM_HOST_IP:-}"
      PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF: expandable_segments:True
      NCCL_IB_HCA: "${NCCL_IB_HCA:-}"
      NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME: "${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME:-}"
      NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX: "${NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX:-}"
      NCCL_IB_GID_AUTO: "1"
      NCCL_IB_ADDR_FAMILY: AF_INET
      NCCL_IB_ROCE_VERSION_NUM: 2
      NCCL_IB_DISABLE: "0"
      NCCL_CROSS_NIC: "1"
      NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE: "0"
      NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE: "0"
      NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY: "1"
      NCCL_DEBUG: WARN
    command:
      - bash
      - -lc
      - >
        export PATH="/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/bin:$${PATH:-}";
        export CUDA_HOME="$${CUDA_HOME:-/usr/local/cuda}";
        export CUDA_PATH="$${CUDA_PATH:-$${CUDA_HOME}}";
        export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/usr/local/cuda/lib64:$${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}";
        if [ -d /opt/fw/vllm-cache-seed ] && [ -n "$(ls -A /opt/fw/vllm-cache-seed)" ]; then
          mkdir -p /cache/vllm-cache && cp -an /opt/fw/vllm-cache-seed/. /cache/vllm-cache/;
          echo "[fw] vllm-cache seed seeded from image";
        fi;
        exec vllm serve ${DSPARK_MODEL:-deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731}
        --served-model-name ${SERVED_MODEL_NAME:-deepseek-v4-flash-0731}
        --host 0.0.0.0
        --port ${VLLM_PORT:-8000}
        --trust-remote-code
        --tensor-parallel-size ${TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZE:-2}
        --kv-cache-dtype ${KV_CACHE_DTYPE:-nvfp4_ds_mla}
        --block-size ${BLOCK_SIZE:-256}
        --max-model-len ${MAX_MODEL_LEN:-1048576}
        --max-num-seqs ${MAX_NUM_SEQS:-6}
        --max-num-batched-tokens ${MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS:-8192}
        --max-cudagraph-capture-size ${MAX_CUDAGRAPH_CAPTURE_SIZE:-36}
        --gpu-memory-utilization ${GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION:-0.88}
        --enable-prefix-caching\n        --enable-prompt-tokens-details
        --enable-flashinfer-autotune
        --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v4
        --tool-call-parser deepseek_v4
        --enable-auto-tool-choice
        --reasoning-parser deepseek_v4
        --load-format instanttensor
        --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":${NUM_SPECULATIVE_TOKENS:-5},"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic"}'
        --distributed-executor-backend mp
        --nnodes ${NODES_TOTAL:-2}
        --node-rank ${NODE_RANK}
        --master-addr ${MASTER_ADDR}
        --master-port ${MASTER_PORT:-25000}
        ${HEADLESS:+--headless}

variables.label: 专属镜像
variables.help: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 专属镜像（主流 vLLM v0.26.0 + GB10 overlay）；从已拉取镜像中选择
variables.help_en: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 dedicated image (mainline vLLM v0.26.0 + GB10 overlay); pick from pulled images

variables.label: 模型
variables.help: 从已下载模型中选择（控制平面下载后分发到各节点 HF 缓存，镜像离线加载）
variables.help_en: Pick from downloaded models (distributed to node HF caches; image loads offline)

variables.label: vLLM API 端口
variables.help: 健康检查将轮询 head 节点该端口的 /v1/models

variables.label: KV cache 量化类型
variables.help: DS-MLA 4-bit KV（已验证 1M 上下文）；nvfp4_ds_mla 推荐，fp8_ds_mla 可用
variables.help_en: DS-MLA 4-bit KV (validated at 1M context); nvfp4_ds_mla recommended, fp8_ds_mla works

variables.label: GPU 显存利用率
variables.help: 1M 上下文需 ≥0.88（DeepGEMM 栈权重占用；0.80 仅 b12x 栈可行）
variables.help_en: 1M context needs ≥0.88 (DeepGEMM weight footprint; 0.80 only on the b12x stack)

variables.label: KV 缓存 block 大小
最大 CUDA Graph 捕获页
张量并行数
variables.help: 默认 2（GB10 每机 1 GPU，TP=节点数=2；已按双节点拓扑调优，不建议更改）
variables.help_en: Default 2 (1 GPU per GB10 node, TP = node count = 2; tuned for the 2-node topology, keep as is)

variables.label: Head 集群地址（任务级 head 的 RoCE IP）
variables.help: 自动填充当前任务的 head 节点 RoCE IP（随任务指定，与集群成员/历史角色无关）
variables.label_en: Head cluster addr (task head's RoCE IP)
variables.help_en: Filled with the current task head's RoCE IP (per-task, independent of cluster membership)

variables.label: 分布式主端口
variables.help: 分布式主端口（Master 端口，属配方用户变量；head rank0 监听）
variables.help_en: Distributed master port (recipe user variable; head rank 0 listens)

variables.label: 节点总数
variables.help: 由任务节点数自动填充（本配方为固定 2 节点拓扑，发布时校验恰好匹配）
variables.help_en: Auto-filled from task node count (fixed 2-node topology; publish validates exact match)

variables.label: Headless（worker 不跑 API server）
variables.help: 自动按角色填充：head 空、worker 1（mp 多节点协调必需）

variables.label: 本节点 vLLM 绑定 IP
variables.help: 各节点 RoCE IP，避免分布式绑定错误地址

variables.label: RoCE HCA
variables.help: 多 HCA 逗号分隔，自动选择全部可用链路
variables.help_en: Multiple HCAs comma-separated; auto-selects all usable links

variables.label: NCCL 网络接口
variables.help: 自动解析主用 RoCE 口 netdev
variables.help_en: Auto-resolves the primary RoCE interface netdev

variables.label: RoCE GID index
variables.help: 每节点/HCA 不同且重启漂移，自动解析 RoCEv2 GID
variables.help_en: Differs per node/HCA and drifts across reboots; auto-resolves the RoCEv2 GID

description_en: Dedicated-image 2-node TP=2 vLLM serving for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731: GB10-targeted overlay, InstantTensor fast load, dspark speculation, quantized DS-MLA KV, 1M context.
